provisionalSurvivor.name: Claim/Event Projection Model
provisionalSurvivor.compression: No universal Resource lifecycle state survives. Keep three basic planes separate: (1) Reality/relation support for Resource; (2) epistemic/native claim evidence with claim-local currentness; (3) historical events/effects. Derive ActionableResourceFor/Option and workflow lanes as demand/as_of projections. Candidate is an epistemic role, not lifecycle state.

centralResult: No universal Resource lifecycle state survives. Persist/reconcile owner-native Events and claim-specific truth; derive Resource/ActionableResourceFor/Option and workflow lanes as actor/demand/as_of projections. State machines belong at owner-native boundaries where one owner defines and reconciles the transitions.
